top_signals.title: 10-year Treasury yield climbs back to 5% after Fed hikes rates, Warsh highlights inflation risks
top_signals.summary: The 10-year Treasury note yield traded near the key 5% mark after a Federal Reserve rate increase and comments from Chairman Kevin Warsh highlighting persistent inflation risks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
